title: Emrys and the Inheritance
author: Emrys Ravensworth
blurb: Jonah Amberdale, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
